en.title: Show global help and available Make targets
en.summary: Shows the global help: lists all available Make targets and explains the overall flow structure. Use this when you are not looking for help on a specific sub-flow (IP, SoC, DOC, FSM).

it.title: Mostra help globale e target Make disponibili
it.summary: Mostra l’help globale: elenca tutti i target Make disponibili e spiega la struttura generale dei flow. Usalo quando non cerchi aiuto su un flow specifico (IP, SoC, DOC, FSM).

en.title: Show help for IP development flow
en.summary: Shows help specific to the IP flow: available Make targets, entrypoints, and commands related to IP development and verification. Does not include SoC or documentation flows.
queries: how do I work on an IP?

it.title: Mostra help per il flow di sviluppo IP
it.summary: Mostra l’help specifico del flow IP: target Make, entrypoint e comandi relativi allo sviluppo e alla verifica di IP. Non include flow SoC o documentazione.

en.title: Show help for SoC integration flow
en.summary: Shows help specific to the SoC flow: Make targets and commands used for SoC integration, build, and verification. Does not include IP-only or documentation flows.
queries: how do I build the soc?

it.title: Mostra help per il flow di integrazione SoC
it.summary: Mostra l’help specifico del flow SoC: target Make e comandi per integrazione, build e verifica del SoC. Non include flow IP o documentazione.

en.title: Show help for documentation generation flow
en.summary: Shows help specific to the documentation flow: Make targets and commands used to generate documentation (e.g. regmap, CSR, HTML/PDF outputs).

it.title: Mostra help per il flow di documentazione
it.summary: Mostra l’help specifico del flow di documentazione: target Make e comandi per generare documentazione (regmap, CSR, output HTML/PDF).

en.title: Show help for FSM generation flow
en.summary: Shows help specific to the FSM flow: Make targets and commands related to finite-state machine generation, visualization, or checking.
queries: how do I generate an fsm?

it.title: Mostra help per il flow FSM
it.summary: Mostra l’help specifico del flow FSM: target Make e comandi relativi alla generazione, visualizzazione o verifica di macchine a stati finiti.

en.title: Initialize workspace (base setup)
en.summary: Creates the base workspace structure (logs/, build/, runs/, output directories) required to work with the flow. This is a generic initialization step and does not create models, constraints, testbenches, or tool-specific flows.
queries: How do I initialize the workspace?

it.title: Inizializza workspace (setup base)
it.summary: Crea la struttura base di lavoro (logs/, build/, runs/, output) necessaria per usare il flow. È un setup generico: non prepara modelli, vincoli SDC, testbench o flow specifici (syn/signoff/pnr).
queries: Crea le cartelle base del progetto

en.title: Set up reference / behavioral model environment
en.summary: Prepares the model environment used for simulation and verification (reference model / behavioral model / golden model assets). Use this when model files are required. This is not the generic workspace setup.
queries: I need the model assets for simulation

it.title: Prepara ambiente modello (reference/behavioral)
it.summary: Prepara l’ambiente *modello* per simulazione e verifica (modello di riferimento / behavioral / golden model e relativi asset). Usalo quando servono file del modello. Non è il setup generico del workspace.
queries: Mi servono gli asset del modello per simulazione

en.title: Set up timing constraints (SDC template)
en.summary: Creates/initializes SDC timing constraints used by synthesis and STA: clocks, I/O delays, false paths, multicycle paths, and timing exceptions.
queries: Set up clocks and timing constraints
Where do I define IO delays?

it.title: Prepara vincoli di timing (template SDC)
it.summary: Crea/inizializza i vincoli di timing in SDC usati da sintesi e STA: clock, ritardi I/O, false path, multicycle path e eccezioni di timing.
queries: Imposta clock e vincoli di timing

en.title: Set up synthesis flow (RTL → netlist)
en.summary: Creates the synthesis run environment and config for RTL synthesis (e.g., tool scripts, synth settings, netlist outputs). Use this before running synthesis.

it.title: Prepara flow di sintesi (RTL → netlist)
it.summary: Crea l’ambiente di run e la configurazione per la sintesi RTL (script tool, impostazioni di sintesi, output netlist). Usalo prima di lanciare la sintesi.

en.title: Set up signoff checks (STA / power / final analysis)
en.summary: Creates the environment for signoff analysis: static timing analysis (STA), power analysis, and late-stage verification configs. Use this for final timing/power checks.

it.title: Prepara verifiche signoff (STA / power / analisi finale)
it.summary: Crea l’ambiente per analisi di signoff: static timing analysis (STA), power analysis e configurazioni di verifica in fase finale. Usalo per controlli finali di timing/power.

en.title: Set up place & route (PnR / physical design)
en.summary: Creates the physical design (PnR) run environment and configuration: floorplan/place/route stages, technology files, and OpenROAD/PD settings. Use this before running PnR.

it.title: Prepara place & route (PnR / physical design)
it.summary: Crea l’ambiente di run e la configurazione per il physical design (PnR): fasi floorplan/place/route, file tecnologici e impostazioni per OpenROAD/PD. Usalo prima di lanciare il PnR.

en.title: Set up RTL testbench environment (HDL TB)
en.summary: Creates the environment for classic HDL RTL testbenches (tb files, sim run directories, basic simulation scaffolding). Use this to prepare a Verilog/SystemVerilog testbench flow (not cocotb).

it.title: Prepara ambiente testbench RTL (TB HDL)
it.summary: Crea l’ambiente per testbench RTL in HDL (file tb, directory di run simulazione, scaffolding base). Usalo per un testbench Verilog/SystemVerilog classico (non cocotb).
queries: Crea directory di run per TB

en.title: Set up cocotb test environment (Python-driven verification)
en.summary: Creates the cocotb-based verification environment: Python test scaffolding, cocotb test directory structure, and simulation integration hooks. Use this for cocotb tests (not HDL-only TB).
queries: How do I run cocotb tests?

it.title: Prepara ambiente cocotb (verifica pilotata da Python)
it.summary: Crea l’ambiente di verifica basato su cocotb: scaffolding test Python, struttura cartelle cocotb e hook di integrazione con la simulazione. Usalo per test cocotb (non testbench HDL puro).

en.title: Quickstart IP pipeline (first run): ip_start
en.summary: Runs the beginner-friendly IP quickstart pipeline: generate reg/doc, create RTL stub/testbench scaffolding, and run a basic simulation. Use this for the first end-to-end run to validate the IP setup (not the full physical/signoff flow).

it.title: Quickstart pipeline IP (prima esecuzione): ip_start
it.summary: Esegue la pipeline IP di quickstart: genera reg/doc, crea scaffolding (RTL stub/testbench) e lancia una simulazione base. Usalo per il primo end-to-end per verificare che l’IP sia configurato correttamente (non è il flow completo con PnR/signoff).

en.title: Standard IP flow (daily/CI): ip_flow
en.summary: Runs the standard end-to-end IP flow for daily development/CI: lint + compile + simulation, plus synthesis and analysis (STA/power) and viewing results. Use this when you want a full check of the IP (but not full PnR/signoff).
queries: run lint compile sim syn sta power

it.title: Flow IP standard (daily/CI): ip_flow
it.summary: Esegue il flow IP end-to-end standard per sviluppo quotidiano/CI: lint + compile + simulazione, più sintesi e analisi (STA/power) e visualizzazione risultati. Usalo per un check completo dell’IP (ma non include PnR/signoff completo).
queries: lint compile sim syn sta power

en.title: Fast IP flow (skip reg/doc): ip_flow_noreg
en.summary: Runs the IP flow without regenerating regmap/docs. Use this for fast RTL iteration when registers and documentation have not changed: lint + compile + sim + syn/STA/power + view, but no reg/doc steps.
queries: fast ip flow for rtl changes

it.title: Flow IP veloce (salta reg/doc): ip_flow_noreg
it.summary: Esegue il flow IP senza rigenerare regmap/documentazione. Usalo per iterare velocemente su modifiche RTL quando registri e doc non sono cambiati: lint + compile + sim + syn/STA/power + view, ma senza reg/doc.
queries: salta doc e lancia il flow
flow ip veloce per modifiche rtl

en.title: Full IP flow incl. PnR + signoff (heavy): ip_flow_all
en.summary: Runs the most complete IP pipeline including physical design steps: lint/compile/sim, synthesis + STA/power, plus PnR and signoff checks. Use this for release-quality verification; it is heavier and may take longer.
queries: run full ip flow with pnr

it.title: Flow IP completo con PnR + signoff (pesante): ip_flow_all
it.summary: Esegue la pipeline IP più completa includendo step di physical design: lint/compile/sim, sintesi + STA/power, più PnR e verifiche di signoff. Usalo per verifiche da release; è più pesante e può richiedere più tempo.

en.title: Guided tutorial for IP flow (learning mode): ip_tutorial
en.summary: Runs guided tutorial steps and example flows to learn the project and IP pipeline. Use this for onboarding and demos rather than CI or signoff runs.
queries: show me an example ip flow

it.title: Tutorial guidato del flow IP (learning mode): ip_tutorial
it.summary: Esegue step guidati ed esempi per imparare il progetto e la pipeline IP. Usalo per onboarding e demo, non per CI o signoff.
queries: fammi vedere un esempio di flow ip

en.title: Save workspace cache / artifacts snapshot: ip_save
en.summary: Saves a snapshot of generated artifacts/cache to speed up later iterations (e.g., after a successful run). Use this to store the current generated state so it can be restored quickly.

it.title: Salva snapshot di cache/artefatti workspace: ip_save
it.summary: Salva uno snapshot di artefatti/cache generati per accelerare iterazioni future (ad esempio dopo una run riuscita). Usalo per memorizzare lo stato corrente così da ripristinarlo rapidamente.

en.title: Restore workspace cache / artifacts snapshot: ip_load
en.summary: Restores a previously saved snapshot of generated artifacts/cache to speed up work. Use this to reload a known-good generated state instead of rebuilding everything from scratch.

it.title: Ripristina snapshot di cache/artefatti workspace: ip_load
it.summary: Ripristina uno snapshot salvato di artefatti/cache per lavorare più velocemente. Usalo per ricaricare uno stato generato noto e funzionante invece di rigenerare tutto da zero.

en.title: Create a register-map HJSON template: hjson
en.summary: Generates the starting HJSON template for an IP register map (CSR/regmap spec). Use this when you are starting a new IP or need a fresh register description skeleton before generating RTL or docs.
queries: make a CSR template in HJSON

it.title: Crea un template HJSON per regmap/registri: hjson
it.summary: Genera il template iniziale HJSON per la mappa registri di un IP (spec CSR/regmap). Usalo quando inizi un nuovo IP o vuoi uno skeleton pulito della descrizione registri prima di generare RTL o documentazione.
queries: crea un template per la mappa registri
genera skeleton hjson per i registri

en.title: Generate RTL CSR/register block from HJSON: reg
en.summary: Generates the SystemVerilog register/CSR implementation from the HJSON regmap specification (RTL register block, address decode, fields). Use this when the register spec changed and you want updated RTL.
queries: update register block after changing regmap

it.title: Genera RTL registri/CSR da HJSON: reg
it.summary: Genera l’implementazione SystemVerilog dei registri/CSR dalla specifica HJSON (blocco registri RTL, decode indirizzi, field). Usalo quando cambi la regmap e vuoi aggiornare l’RTL.
queries: aggiorna register block dopo modifiche regmap

en.title: Generate documentation from regmap/HJSON: doc
en.summary: Builds human-readable documentation from the HJSON register map (CSR tables, address map, register fields). Use this to produce docs (HTML/PDF/Markdown depending on the flow), not RTL generation.

it.title: Genera documentazione da regmap/HJSON: doc
it.summary: Genera documentazione leggibile dalla regmap HJSON (tabelle CSR, address map, field dei registri). Usalo per produrre docs (HTML/PDF/Markdown a seconda del flow), non per generare RTL.

en.title: Generate RTL module skeleton / stub: rtl_stub
en.summary: Creates a starter RTL skeleton for a new IP (module/interface placeholders, basic structure). Use this when bootstrapping a new block, not for regmap/doc generation.
queries: generate module stub for a new IP

it.title: Genera skeleton / stub RTL: rtl_stub
it.summary: Crea uno scheletro RTL iniziale per un nuovo IP (placeholder modulo/interfacce, struttura base). Usalo per bootstrap di un blocco nuovo, non per regmap/doc.
queries: genera stub di modulo per un nuovo IP

en.title: Generate tool filelists (RTL/TB sources): flist
en.summary: Generates filelists for tools (simulators/lint/synthesis): ordered source lists, include paths, and tool-friendly input lists. Use this when tools need an updated list of RTL/TB files.
queries: generate a filelist for the simulator

it.title: Genera filelist per i tool (sorgenti RTL/TB): flist
it.summary: Genera filelist per i tool (simulatori/lint/sintesi): liste sorgenti ordinate, include path e input per tool. Usalo quando serve aggiornare la lista dei file RTL/TB.
queries: aggiorna filelist sorgenti per i tool

en.title: Flatten/convert SystemVerilog to Verilog: sv2v
en.summary: Converts SystemVerilog sources into plain Verilog for tools that do not support SV. Often produces a single merged Verilog file or a tool-compatible output set.
queries: make a Verilog-only version of the RTL
flatten SV sources for synthesis tool

it.title: Converti/flatten SystemVerilog in Verilog: sv2v
it.summary: Converte sorgenti SystemVerilog in Verilog puro per tool che non supportano SV. Tipicamente produce un Verilog ‘merged’ o un set di output compatibile col tool.
queries: crea una versione solo Verilog dell’RTL
flatten sorgenti SV per tool di sintesi

en.title: Fetch vendor / third-party dependencies (from HJSON): fetch
en.summary: Fetches external/vendor IP or third-party sources referenced by the project (often described in config/HJSON). Use this when dependencies are missing or you need to refresh vendor checkouts.
queries: get missing dependencies for the project

it.title: Scarica dipendenze vendor / terze parti (da HJSON): fetch
it.summary: Scarica dipendenze esterne/vendor o sorgenti third-party referenziate dal progetto (spesso descritte in config/HJSON). Usalo quando mancano dipendenze o vuoi aggiornare i checkout vendor.

en.title: Static RTL lint checks (no simulation): lint
en.summary: Runs static lint on RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog): style/sanity checks, common bug patterns, and produces lint reports. Use this before compile/sim to catch issues early.

it.title: Controlli lint RTL statici (senza simulazione): lint
it.summary: Esegue lint statico su RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog): controlli di stile/sanity, pattern di bug comuni e genera report di lint. Usalo prima di compile/sim per intercettare problemi presto.

en.title: Compile RTL/testbench for simulation (build only): compile
en.summary: Build step for simulation: compiles RTL + testbench into a simulator executable/library. Use this when you want to build the sim without running it yet (no waveforms produced here).
queries: just build sim, do not run

it.title: Compila RTL/testbench per simulazione (solo build): compile
it.summary: Step di build per la simulazione: compila RTL + testbench in un eseguibile/libreria del simulatore. Usalo quando vuoi compilare senza eseguire (qui non si generano waveform).

en.title: Run RTL simulation (produce waveforms): sim
en.summary: Executes the simulation run for the selected RTL/testbench configuration and produces results such as waveforms (VCD/FST) and run reports. Use this to actually run the sim (not just compile).

it.title: Esegui simulazione RTL (genera waveform): sim
it.summary: Esegue la simulazione per la configurazione RTL/testbench selezionata e produce risultati come waveform (VCD/FST) e report di run. Usalo per eseguire davvero la sim (non solo compile).

en.title: Run cocotb tests (Python testbench): cocotb
en.summary: Runs cocotb-based verification using Python testbench/tests. Use this when verification is driven by cocotb (pytest/cocotb), not by a pure HDL testbench.

it.title: Esegui test cocotb (testbench Python): cocotb
it.summary: Esegue verifica basata su cocotb con testbench/test in Python. Usalo quando la verifica è guidata da cocotb (pytest/cocotb), non da un testbench HDL puro.

en.title: Run cocotb regression suite (multiple tests): regression
en.summary: Runs a regression suite (many cocotb tests, often longer). Use this for full verification runs/CI-style checks, not for a single quick cocotb test.

it.title: Esegui suite di regression cocotb (molti test): regression
it.summary: Esegue una suite di regression (molti test cocotb, spesso più lunga). Usalo per run di verifica complete/stile CI, non per un singolo test cocotb veloce.
queries: esegui tutti i test di verifica

en.title: RTL synthesis (generate netlist + reports): syn
en.summary: Runs synthesis (typically Yosys) to transform RTL into a gate-level netlist and generates synthesis reports (area/timing summaries). Use this for synthesis results, not for simulation.

it.title: Sintesi RTL (genera netlist + report): syn
it.summary: Esegue la sintesi (tipicamente Yosys) trasformando RTL in netlist gate-level e genera report di sintesi (riassunti area/timing). Usalo per risultati di sintesi, non per simulazione.

en.title: Yosys Verilog/netlist generation step: yosys-vgen
en.summary: Runs the Yosys netlist generation/export step (Verilog generation). Use this when you specifically want the generated Verilog/netlist output from synthesis, not the full synthesis/report flow.

it.title: Generazione netlist/Verilog con Yosys: yosys-vgen
it.summary: Esegue lo step di generazione/export della netlist con Yosys (generazione Verilog). Usalo quando vuoi esplicitamente l’output Verilog/netlist della sintesi, non l’intero flow.

en.title: Post-synthesis plots/graphs (timing/area summaries): plot_postsyn
en.summary: Generates plots/graphs from synthesis results (post-syn summaries such as timing/area trends). Use this when you want visual reports/plots, not to run synthesis itself.

it.title: Plot/grafici post-sintesi (riassunti timing/area): plot_postsyn
it.summary: Genera plot/grafici dai risultati di sintesi (riassunti post-syn come timing/area). Usalo quando vuoi visualizzazioni, non per eseguire la sintesi.

en.title: Compile gate-level netlist for simulation (post-syn): compile_syn
en.summary: Compiles the synthesized gate-level netlist + testbench for simulation (post-synthesis simulation build). Use this for gate-level (post-syn) compilation, not RTL compile.

it.title: Compila netlist gate-level per simulazione (post-syn): compile_syn
it.summary: Compila la netlist sintetizzata gate-level + testbench per la simulazione (build di simulazione post-sintesi). Usalo per compile post-syn, non per compile RTL.

en.title: Run gate-level simulation (post-syn): sim_syn
en.summary: Runs simulation using the synthesized gate-level netlist (post-synthesis). Use this to validate the synthesized design behavior (often slower) and produce waveforms for the netlist-level sim.
queries: run netlist simulation and dump waves

it.title: Esegui simulazione gate-level (post-syn): sim_syn
it.summary: Esegue la simulazione usando la netlist gate-level sintetizzata (post-sintesi). Usalo per validare il comportamento del design sintetizzato (spesso più lento) e generare waveform a livello netlist.
queries: run simulazione netlist e genera waveform

en.title: Static Timing Analysis (STA) signoff: sta
en.summary: Runs static timing analysis to evaluate timing constraints and slack. Use this for timing closure checks (reports, worst paths), not for simulation or power estimation.

it.title: Analisi temporale statica (STA) signoff: sta
it.summary: Esegue STA per valutare vincoli di timing e slack. Usalo per controlli di timing closure (report, worst path), non per simulazione o stima power.

en.title: Power analysis signoff: power
en.summary: Runs power estimation/analysis (dynamic/leakage depending on flow) and generates power reports. Use this when you need power numbers, not timing slack or SDF export.

it.title: Analisi potenza signoff: power
it.summary: Esegue analisi/stima di potenza (dinamica/leakage a seconda del flow) e genera report di potenza. Usalo quando ti servono numeri di power, non slack timing o export SDF.

en.title: STA violations / worst paths report: sta_violators
en.summary: Reports STA constraint violations and worst failing paths (negative slack, endpoints, violated constraints). Use this to quickly find timing violators, not to run full PnR or power analysis.

it.title: Violazioni STA / worst path: sta_violators
it.summary: Mostra violazioni dei vincoli STA e i worst failing path (slack negativo, endpoint, vincoli violati). Usalo per trovare rapidamente i violatori di timing, non per PnR o analisi power.

en.title: Export SDF timing annotation file: sdf
en.summary: Generates an SDF file for back-annotation (timing annotation) used in gate-level simulation. Use this when you need an SDF export, not a timing slack report or power numbers.

it.title: Esporta file SDF per back-annotation: sdf
it.summary: Genera il file SDF per back-annotation (annotazione timing) usato nella simulazione gate-level. Usalo quando ti serve l’export SDF, non report slack o numeri di potenza.

en.title: Place-and-route flow (batch run): pnr
en.summary: Runs the physical design place-and-route flow (typically OpenROAD) in batch mode: floorplan/placement/routing and generated outputs (DEF, reports, etc.). Use this to run PnR, not to open the GUI.

it.title: Flow place-and-route (batch): pnr
it.summary: Esegue il flow di physical design place-and-route (tipicamente OpenROAD) in modalità batch: floorplan/placement/routing e output generati (DEF, report, ecc.). Usalo per lanciare il PnR, non per aprire la GUI.

en.title: Open OpenROAD interactive GUI session: pnr_gui
en.summary: Opens an interactive OpenROAD GUI session for debugging/inspection of the physical design (floorplan/placement/routing). Use this when you explicitly want the GUI, not a batch PnR run.
queries: debug placement and routing in GUI

it.title: Apri la GUI interattiva OpenROAD: pnr_gui
it.summary: Apre una sessione GUI interattiva di OpenROAD per debug/ispezione del physical design (floorplan/placement/routing). Usalo quando vuoi esplicitamente la GUI, non un run batch di PnR.
queries: debug placement e routing in GUI

en.title: View latest simulation outputs (generic viewer): view
en.summary: Opens the default viewer for the latest run: waveforms (VCD/FST) and basic simulation reports. Use this as the generic 'show me the waves' command when you don't care which stage produced them.

it.title: Visualizza output ultima simulazione (viewer generico): view
it.summary: Apre il viewer di default per l’ultima run: waveform (VCD/FST) e report base di simulazione. Usalo come comando generico 'fammi vedere le waveform' quando non ti interessa lo stage specifico.

en.title: View cocotb test waveforms/logs: view_cocotb
en.summary: Opens waveforms and logs generated by cocotb (Python-based) tests. Use this when your failing/passing run was driven by cocotb, not a pure HDL testbench.

it.title: Visualizza waveform/log cocotb: view_cocotb
it.summary: Apre waveform e log generati da test cocotb (testbench in Python). Usalo quando la run è guidata da cocotb, non da un testbench HDL puro.

en.title: View RTL / pre-synthesis simulation (pre-syn): view_presyn
en.summary: Views outputs from the RTL (pre-synthesis) stage: pre-syn simulation waveforms and reports. Use this when you want the pure RTL behavior before synthesis/gate-level changes.

it.title: Visualizza simulazione RTL pre-sintesi (pre-syn): view_presyn
it.summary: Visualizza output dello stage RTL (pre-sintesi): waveform e report della simulazione pre-syn. Usalo quando vuoi vedere il comportamento RTL puro prima di sintesi/gate-level.

en.title: View synthesis outputs (netlist/reports): view_syn
en.summary: Views synthesis results: generated netlist, area/timing reports, and post-synthesis artifacts. Use this to inspect synthesis output (not RTL waves, not STA path inspection).

it.title: Visualizza output di sintesi (netlist/report): view_syn
it.summary: Visualizza risultati di sintesi: netlist generata, report area/timing e artefatti post-sintesi. Usalo per ispezionare la sintesi (non waveform RTL, non ispezione path STA).

en.title: Inspect timing paths / STA reports (critical path): path_view
en.summary: Opens or summarizes STA/signoff timing reports to inspect critical paths, slack, constraints, and (optionally) power/SDF outputs. Use this for timing-path analysis, not waveform viewing.

it.title: Ispeziona timing path / report STA (critical path): path_view
it.summary: Apre o riassume report STA/signoff per ispezionare critical path, slack, vincoli e (opzionalmente) output power/SDF. Usalo per analisi di timing-path, non per vedere waveform.

en.title: View HDL testbench simulation (TB waves): tb_view
en.summary: Views waveforms produced by the classic HDL testbench (tb). Use this when your simulation is driven by an HDL TB (Verilog/SystemVerilog), not cocotb.

it.title: Visualizza simulazione testbench HDL (onde TB): tb_view
it.summary: Visualizza le waveform prodotte dal testbench HDL classico (tb). Usalo quando la simulazione è guidata da un TB Verilog/SystemVerilog, non da cocotb.

en.title: View SoC integration outputs (SoC reports/artifacts): soc_view
en.summary: Views outputs specific to the SoC integration flow (fabric/crossbar/full SoC build). Use this to inspect SoC-level build/run artifacts and reports, not IP-only waveforms.

it.title: Visualizza output integrazione SoC (report/artefatti SoC): soc_view
it.summary: Visualizza output specifici del flow di integrazione SoC (fabric/crossbar/build SoC completo). Usalo per ispezionare artefatti e report a livello SoC, non waveform IP-only.

en.title: Build or generate driver sources
en.summary: Utilities for IP development: regmap/CSR generation, documentation, filelists, source conversion, and vendor fetching.
queries: How do I use the 'driver' make target?

it.title: Crea o genera sorgenti driver
it.summary: Utility per sviluppo IP: generazione regmap/CSR, documentazione, filelist, conversione sorgenti e fetch vendor.
queries: Come si usa il target make 'driver'?

en.title: SoC integration base setup: soc
en.summary: Performs the base SoC integration setup: prepares the SoC workspace and integration artifacts (e.g., fabric/crossbar integration). Use this as the generic SoC entrypoint before running SoC simulation or run flows.

it.title: Setup base integrazione SoC: soc
it.summary: Esegue il setup base di integrazione SoC: prepara workspace e artefatti di integrazione (es. fabric/crossbar). Usalo come entrypoint generico SoC prima di lanciare simulazione o run.

en.title: SoC variant build (Ibex-based SoC): soc_ibex
en.summary: Sets up / builds the Ibex-based SoC variant. Use this when you explicitly want the SoC configuration that includes the Ibex core (as opposed to generic SoC setup or running simulations).

it.title: Variante SoC (SoC con core Ibex): soc_ibex
it.summary: Imposta / costruisce la variante di SoC basata su Ibex. Usalo quando vuoi esplicitamente la configurazione SoC con core Ibex (non il setup generico SoC o la sola simulazione/run).

en.title: SoC end-to-end flow (build + sim + view): soc_flow
en.summary: Runs the complete SoC pipeline end-to-end: integration/build (including crossbar), SoC simulation, and viewing/inspection of results. Use this for a full SoC validation run (heavier than soc_sim alone).

it.title: Flow SoC end-to-end (build + sim + view): soc_flow
it.summary: Esegue la pipeline SoC completa end-to-end: integrazione/build (incluso crossbar), simulazione SoC e visualizzazione/ispezione dei risultati. Usalo per una validazione completa del SoC (più pesante di soc_sim da solo).

en.title: Simulate the SoC (SoC-level simulation): soc_sim
en.summary: Runs SoC-level simulation after integration/build (including crossbar). Use this when you specifically want to simulate the SoC (not the full end-to-end flow, and not a runtime/boot run).

it.title: Simula il SoC (simulazione a livello SoC): soc_sim
it.summary: Esegue la simulazione a livello SoC dopo integrazione/build (incluso crossbar). Usalo quando vuoi specificamente simulare il SoC (non il flow end-to-end completo e non un run/boot runtime).

en.title: Run/boot the SoC (runtime execution): soc_run
en.summary: Runs the SoC in runtime mode (e.g., boot or execute firmware/programs) after SoC integration/build. Use this for running/booting the SoC, not for simulation-only or report viewing.

it.title: Esegui/boota il SoC (runtime): soc_run
it.summary: Esegue il SoC in modalità runtime (es. boot o esecuzione firmware/programmi) dopo integrazione/build. Usalo per run/boot del SoC, non per sola simulazione o visualizzazione report.

en.title: Clean documentation outputs (doc/regmap artifacts): clean_doc
en.summary: Removes generated documentation outputs: doc build directory, generated regmap/CSR docs, HTML/PDF outputs and related intermediate files. Use when docs/regmap were regenerated and you want a clean rebuild.

it.title: Pulisci output documentazione (doc/regmap): clean_doc
it.summary: Rimuove gli output generati della documentazione: directory doc, documenti regmap/CSR, output HTML/PDF e file intermedi. Usalo quando vuoi rigenerare docs/regmap da zero.

en.title: Clean logs only (keep build artifacts): clean_log
en.summary: Removes log files produced by runs (stderr/stdout logs, tool logs, run logs). Use when you want to keep build outputs but reset logs for a fresh run/debug.

it.title: Pulisci solo i log (mantieni gli artefatti): clean_log
it.summary: Rimuove i file di log prodotti dalle run (log tool, stderr/stdout, log di esecuzione). Usalo quando vuoi tenere gli output di build ma ripartire con log puliti per debug.

en.title: Clean RTL/generated source artifacts: clean_rtl
en.summary: Removes generated RTL/source artifacts such as stubs, generated HDL, filelists, or converted sources. Use when you want to regenerate RTL-derived files (not just logs).

it.title: Pulisci artefatti RTL/sorgenti generate: clean_rtl
it.summary: Rimuove artefatti RTL/sorgenti generati come stub, HDL generato, filelist o sorgenti convertite. Usalo quando vuoi rigenerare file derivati dall’RTL (non solo i log).

en.title: Clean simulation outputs (RTL sim build/run dirs): clean_sim
en.summary: Removes simulation build/run artifacts: compiled simulation outputs, run directories, waveform dumps, and sim reports. Use when simulation is stale or you want a clean sim rebuild.

it.title: Pulisci output simulazione (build/run sim): clean_sim
it.summary: Rimuove artefatti di build/run della simulazione: output compilati, directory di run, dump waveform e report. Usalo quando la simulazione è ‘sporca’ o vuoi rigenerarla da zero.

en.title: Clean cocotb test outputs (Python verification): clean_cocotb
en.summary: Removes cocotb-specific run artifacts: Python test outputs, cocotb logs, sim build dirs for cocotb, and cocotb waveform dumps. Use when cocotb runs are stale or failing due to leftover state.

it.title: Pulisci output cocotb (verifica Python): clean_cocotb
it.summary: Rimuove artefatti specifici dei test cocotb: output test Python, log cocotb, directory di run/build per cocotb e dump waveform. Usalo quando le run cocotb sono sporche o influenzate da stato residuo.

en.title: Clean synthesis outputs (netlist/reports): clean_syn
en.summary: Removes synthesis artifacts: netlists, synthesis reports (area/timing), and synthesis run directories. Use when you want to rerun synthesis from scratch.

it.title: Pulisci output sintesi (netlist/report): clean_syn
it.summary: Rimuove artefatti di sintesi: netlist, report di sintesi (area/timing) e directory di run. Usalo quando vuoi rilanciare la sintesi da zero.

en.title: Clean signoff outputs (STA/power/SDF): clean_signoff
en.summary: Removes signoff analysis artifacts: STA reports, power reports, SDF outputs, and signoff run directories. Use when signoff results are stale and you want a clean signoff rerun.

it.title: Pulisci output signoff (STA/power/SDF): clean_signoff
it.summary: Rimuove artefatti di analisi signoff: report STA, report power, file SDF e directory di run. Usalo quando vuoi rilanciare il signoff da zero perché i risultati sono stantii.

en.title: Clean signoff outputs (STA/power/SDF): clean_signoff
en.summary: Removes signoff analysis artifacts: STA reports, power reports, SDF outputs, and signoff run directories. Use when signoff results are stale and you want a clean signoff rerun.

it.title: Pulisci output signoff (STA/power/SDF): clean_signoff
it.summary: Rimuove artefatti di analisi signoff: report STA, report power, file SDF e directory di run. Usalo quando vuoi rilanciare il signoff da zero perché i risultati sono stantii.

en.title: Clean FSM generation outputs (basic): clean_fsm
en.summary: Removes generated FSM artifacts (basic cleanup): intermediate files and outputs produced by FSM generation/visualization steps. Use this when FSM outputs are stale.

it.title: Pulisci output generazione FSM (base): clean_fsm
it.summary: Rimuove artefatti generati della FSM (pulizia base): file intermedi e output prodotti da generazione/visualizzazione FSM. Usalo quando gli output FSM sono stantii.

en.title: Clean FSM outputs (extended / deep clean): clean_fsm_all
en.summary: Performs an extended FSM cleanup beyond clean_fsm: removes all FSM-generated outputs including cached/derived artifacts. Use when basic clean_fsm is not enough.

it.title: Pulisci FSM in modo esteso (deep clean): clean_fsm_all
it.summary: Esegue una pulizia FSM estesa oltre clean_fsm: rimuove tutti gli output FSM, inclusi artefatti derivati/cache. Usalo quando clean_fsm non basta.

en.title: Clean FlexSoC top-level generated outputs: clean_fsoc
en.summary: Removes FlexSoC/top-level build artifacts and outputs (project-wide). Use when you want to reset top-level generated artifacts without necessarily cleaning SoC-only or IP-only subflows.

it.title: Pulisci output generati top-level FlexSoC: clean_fsoc
it.summary: Rimuove artefatti e output generati top-level di FlexSoC (a livello progetto). Usalo per resettare gli artefatti globali senza necessariamente pulire solo SoC o solo SW.

en.title: Clean SoC build/integration outputs: clean_soc
en.summary: Removes SoC integration/build outputs: SoC build directories, crossbar/fabric generated artifacts, SoC-level run outputs. Use when SoC integration is stale and you want a clean SoC rebuild.

it.title: Pulisci output build/integrazione SoC: clean_soc
it.summary: Rimuove output di integrazione/build SoC: directory di build SoC, artefatti generati per crossbar/fabric e output di run SoC. Usalo quando l’integrazione SoC è stantia e vuoi rigenerare da zero.

en.title: Clean software build outputs (firmware/toolchain): clean_sw
en.summary: Removes software/firmware build outputs: compiled binaries, build directories, intermediate objects. Use when you want to rebuild firmware/software from scratch.

it.title: Pulisci output build software (firmware/toolchain): clean_sw
it.summary: Rimuove output di build software/firmware: binari compilati, directory di build e file intermedi. Usalo quando vuoi ricompilare firmware/software da zero.

en.title: Clean vendor/dependency fetch outputs: clean_vendor
en.summary: Removes fetched vendor sources and dependency directories (third-party IP/libs). Use when vendor checkout is corrupted or you want to refetch dependencies cleanly.

it.title: Pulisci sorgenti vendor/dipendenze scaricate: clean_vendor
it.summary: Rimuove sorgenti vendor e directory dipendenze (third-party IP/librerie). Usalo quando il checkout vendor è corrotto o vuoi riscaricare le dipendenze in modo pulito.

en.title: Clean only the current subdirectory scope: clean_subdir
en.summary: Cleans outputs limited to the current subdirectory/module scope (local cleanup). Use this when working inside a submodule and you do not want to wipe the whole repo outputs.
queries: do not clean everything, just here

it.title: Pulisci solo la subdirectory corrente (scope locale): clean_subdir
it.summary: Pulisce output limitati allo scope della subdirectory/modulo corrente (pulizia locale). Usalo quando lavori in un sottomodulo e non vuoi cancellare tutto il repo.

en.title: Clean most generated outputs (standard clean): clean
en.summary: Runs the standard full cleanup across the project by invoking the main clean_* targets (docs/logs/rtl/sim/syn/pnr/signoff/soc/sw/vendor/subdir). Use with care: this removes a lot of generated outputs.

it.title: Pulisci la maggior parte degli output generati (clean standard): clean
it.summary: Esegue la pulizia standard a livello progetto invocando i principali target clean_* (docs/log/rtl/sim/syn/pnr/signoff/soc/sw/vendor/subdir). Usare con cautela: rimuove molti output generati.

en.title: Deep clean (nuclear reset): clean_all
en.summary: Performs the deepest cleanup: runs `clean` plus extended cleanups (e.g., clean_fsm_all). Use when you want the closest thing to a pristine workspace and are OK losing all caches and derived artifacts.

it.title: Pulizia profonda (reset totale): clean_all
it.summary: Esegue la pulizia più profonda: lancia `clean` più cleanup estesi (es. clean_fsm_all). Usalo quando vuoi uno stato quasi “pristino” e accetti di perdere cache e artefatti derivati.
queries: pulisci tutte le cache e artefatti
